description:
This is a Sources Sought for a brand name new Chlorinator Cell replacement for the water purification system at the Walla Walla VA Medical Center in Walla Walla, WA. The brand name parts required are as follows:

Flow Cell Module DEPOLOX 5 C, non-pressuriized version .

Part No. W3Tl70065 Maintenance parts kit, annual maintenance

Part No. W3Tl7007l Maintenance parts kit, 4 years

Part No. W3Tl58882 Spare Parts Set for flow control valve.

Vendor will confirm proposed parts are domestic end items.

Ven dor will confirm current registration in System for Award Management (SAM ) .
